title: I gotta know what’s better for making games Claude or codex??
author: haveabag

comments.author: Great_Teacher400
comments.body:
I used codex sol and then moved to terra
 Terra medium is great. Not far behind Claude opus for what it's putting out.
I got Claude yesterday and made 3 games with codex over a week or two. I find Claude to be mostly hype and that terra on codex isn't far behind..
Currently Claude is improving systems that codex got lazy with
Prompting codex better helps. I would use Gemini to make a prompt and codex would add it to game.

Note codex sol light was my go to and when they updated terra 6.1, sol became borderline retarded and couldn't do anything at all

replies.author: haveabag
replies.body: Yoo coz I think it’s sol 6.1 I’m using for blender to try and make my characters and it’s struggling hard asf to make them look like anything 😭😭

replies.body: Im usong sol 6.1 on max (not ultra)  and have had no issues other then it seems slower them like astra but its token use is way lower then astra and seems to be just as good, but if oyu put it on ultra it eats tokens for breakfast.

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body: Any model is capable from the current generation given you do the effort of first building a documentation flow with design notes, archetectural notes,  mechanic explanation and rules.

comments.body: For me its been Claude Opus 5.5 High

comments.author: MAIKO-GAMES
comments.body: I prefer Codex Sol 5.6+.... I find it easier to produce better quality images, animations, spritesheets and audio assets with it than with Claude... and it handles game logic pretty well as well.
